candidates.change_summary: Replace return of _owner with return of msg.sender so owner() returns the caller instead of the stored owner.
Replace return of _owner with the zero address so owner() always returns address(0).
Remove the zero-address check so transferring ownership to address(0) succeeds instead of reverting, observable via owner().
Transfer ownership to the caller instead of newOwner, so owner() reflects msg.sender rather than the argument.
Remove the _transferOwnership call so owner() remains unchanged after transferOwnership.
Drop the _checkOwner() check so any caller can call transferOwnership and change owner(), observable via owner().
Always return true instead of the stored pause flag.
Always return false instead of the stored pause flag.
